# Local rendering libraries

Pinned assets for offline document diagrams and code highlighting. No source code
or answers are sent to a remote rendering service.

Downloaded from the versioned jsDelivr npm distribution (Mermaid) and cdnjs
(highlight.js). License texts are stored alongside the assets.
